key_phrases.phrase: What do you like to eat?
The fish is very good here.
key_phrases.translation: Jën wi mu ngi rafet na ci mbirum.

scenario: At the bank for a simple transaction
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Jëkkëli ci jëndëkk ci Wolof: 'dinero' amul jëndëkk.
Ndaxte li ma wax ci Wolof: 'agsi' ci jëndëkk ('agsi ndimbal') walla ci jëndëkk ('agsi ndax')
Dëgg a ci Wolof ci mbirum ci mbirum.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need money now.
dialogue.translation: Dama nekk ndimbal ñaa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here is your card. Go there with your ID.
dialogue.translation: Ñaa laa la card. Yàgg ñaa ak sa téere.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Will you give me more cash?
dialogue.translation: Danga ma agsi ndimbal?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I will give you the money now. Go there.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, dama ma ndimbal ñaa. Yàgg ñaa.
